content.value_statement: Network teams need a fast way to inspect UniFi hosts, devices, and site assignments. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through inventory, status, and configuration review workflows.
actual_capabilities: Lists all hosts across all UniFi sites.
Retrieves detailed host information and status.
Lists network devices across the infrastructure.
Retrieves detailed device configuration and status.
Filters hosts and devices by site.
Supports inventory, health, and resource distribution reports.
limitations: It describes workflows but does not include implementation code.
It depends on connected UniFi management tools for live data.
It does not change device settings or remediate issues automatically.
It cannot verify accuracy when tool responses are incomplete.

use_cases.title: Audit Site Inventory
use_cases.description: Review hosts and devices per site to identify missing, offline, or incorrectly assigned assets.

use_cases.title: Troubleshoot Connectivity
use_cases.description: Inspect device configuration and host status before escalating network incidents.

use_cases.title: Plan Capacity
use_cases.description: Compare resource distribution across locations to plan hardware placement and expansion.

prompt_templates.title: List Infrastructure
prompt_templates.prompt: List all UniFi hosts and devices across every site, then group the results by site.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Site
prompt_templates.prompt: Show hosts and devices for the selected site, including status, device type, and assignment details.

prompt_templates.title: Review Device Configuration
prompt_templates.prompt: Get details for this device and summarize configuration values that look inconsistent with the site standard.

prompt_templates.title: Build Capacity Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare hosts and devices across sites, identify uneven resource distribution, and suggest locations needing capacity planning.

output_examples.input: Show me all network devices and their status.
output_examples.output: A site-grouped device inventory with each device name, status, type, and configuration summary.

output_examples.input: How many hosts and devices do I have per site?
output_examples.output: A readable site summary that compares host counts, device counts, and notable distribution differences.

output_examples.input: Are all devices properly configured and online?
output_examples.output: A review of online status, visible configuration details, and items that need follow-up verification.

best_practices: Confirm the target site or device before requesting details.
Compare host and device lists when investigating connectivity.
Review inventory regularly to keep assignments and names current.
anti_patterns: Do not assume device names identify physical locations without confirmation.
Do not treat stale inventory data as operational truth.
Do not use broad inventory views when a site-specific check is required.

faq.question: Does this skill modify UniFi devices?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflows focus on inventory, status review, and configuration inspection.

faq.question: Which tools does it reference?
faq.answer: It references list_hosts, get_host_details, get_hosts_by_site, list_devices, get_device_details, and get_devices_by_site.

faq.question: Can it filter by site?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes host and device workflows scoped to a specific site.

faq.question: Does it require live UniFi access?
faq.answer: Yes. Current inventory and status depend on connected UniFi management tools.

faq.question: Can it create infrastructure reports?
faq.answer: Yes. It can organize hosts, devices, status, and site distribution into readable reports.

faq.question: Is security monitoring included?
faq.answer: It can surface infrastructure health and configuration details, but it is not a vulnerability scanner.
